viewing_check: Measure thickness and width, check for end splits, through-checks and bark/rot on the live edge, and whether it is dry or green. A thick (50 mm+), wide, crack-free slab justifies the top of the range ($100 to $125 hammer); a thin or split one is likely $20 to $50.
